visual_action: A split-screen video. The top half is a montage of clips showing Donald Trump speaking at podiums in various settings, including rallies and press conferences. The bottom half shows gameplay from the mobile game "Subway Surfers," where a character runs along snowy train tracks, collecting coins and dodging trains.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: He is shown speaking in every clip in the top half of the video, and his voice is the only audio.

cast.name: Barack Obama
cast.evidence: Donald Trump repeatedly refers to "Obamacare," the common name for the Affordable Care Act signed into law by President Barack Obama.

on_screen_text.text: ► Trump wants to take away health care from millions of Americans ◄
and we're going to replace it.
The Repeal and Replace Obamacare Act —
"We're going to do something about it."

spoken_summary: The audio is a montage of Donald Trump speaking, in which he repeatedly states his intention to "repeal and replace Obamacare." He refers to the policy as a "disaster" and consistently repeats phrases like "repeal and replace" throughout the various clips.
audio_music: The audio consists solely of Donald Trump's spoken words from the clips. There is no background music, sound effects, or audible audio from the video game gameplay.
editing_pacing: The video is a fast-paced montage using quick cuts between different clips of Donald Trump speaking. The split-screen format with the gameplay footage remains constant throughout.
central_claim: Donald Trump consistently intends to repeal the Affordable Care Act (Obamacare), which would take healthcare away from millions of Americans.
intended_effect: To cause alarm about Donald Trump's healthcare policies and frame his long-stated goal of repealing Obamacare as a direct threat to the viewer's or their fellow citizens' well-being.
